1962-five-color-map.title_en: 1962: China on a Map in Five Colors
1962-five-color-map.excerpt_en: In 1962, someone colored a map of China's relations with the world in five shades — and almost nowhere around China was white. This is that map's story, and the year that pushed China toward an independent foreign policy.

2001-land-green-smoke.title_en: The Land and the Green Smoke of 2001
2001-land-green-smoke.excerpt_en: In the winter of 2001, photographer Lu Guang captured a boy kneeling before his parents' unmarked graves in Shangcai, Henan — the end of a story that began with a blood-selling scandal that spread HIV through entire villages.

5-30-am-child.title_en: The Child at 5:30 AM: When Hard Work No Longer Promises a Better Future
5-30-am-child.excerpt_en: A three-second clip of a middle-school girl eating breakfast in the back of a car at 5:30 in the morning — and behind it, a whole family running like a machine, and a generation caught in the same race.

biden-promise-me-america.excerpt_en: Former President Joe Biden announces his memoir, PROMISE ME, AMERICA, out November 17 — and shares, with striking candor, that he was diagnosed with cancer while writing it.

deep-state-refuted.title_en: There Is No "Deep State" — and No One "Controls America"
deep-state-refuted.excerpt_en: I don't buy the "deep state" story. Power is a seat — if you're not sitting in it, you don't hold it. And anyone who does sit in it will never give it up.

first-car-electric-bike.title_en: Young People, Don't Rush to Buy a Car: Your First Vehicle Should Be an E-Bike
first-car-electric-bike.excerpt_en: Saved up a hundred or two hundred thousand yuan and eyeing a Tesla or a Xiaomi SU7? A high-end e-bike — and cash left in the bank — buys you far more freedom than a car loan ever will.

flclash.title_en: FlClash: A Free, Open-Source VPN Client (Windows / Android)
flclash.excerpt_en: FlClash is a free, open-source proxy client built on the Mihomo (Clash Meta) core. It runs on Windows, Android, macOS, iOS, and Linux, with a clean interface and a simple setup.

four-people-four-disobediences.title_en: Four People, Four Acts of Defiance
four-people-four-disobediences.excerpt_en: He Zhili refused to throw a match and was erased. Jiao Zhimin threw five and walked away. Fan Zhendong signed his way out and won in silence. And a 71-year-old Italian journalist asked the question no one else dared to.

huang-renxun-identity.title_en: The Jensen Huang Affair: When a Chinese Man Can't Win Either World's Trust
huang-renxun-identity.excerpt_en: Jensen Huang's troubles began as a story about a CEO and a suspected spy. They became something bigger: a test of whether an ethnic Chinese person in America must constantly prove his loyalty — and what that says about freedom.

huang-yasheng-eight-judgments.title_en: Yasheng Huang: Eight Core Judgments on the Economy Today
huang-yasheng-eight-judgments.excerpt_en: The headline numbers look steady, but everyone knows how the economy actually feels. MIT professor Yasheng Huang lays out eight blunt, grounded judgments — no spin, no sugarcoating.

korea-chaebol-politics.title_en: The Truth About South Korea's Chaebols and Politics
korea-chaebol-politics.excerpt_en: Everyone “knows” Samsung and Hyundai run South Korea. But there's one thing a chaebol-controlled country should never have — and South Korea has some of Asia's strongest unions. That contradiction tells the real story.

local-boom-systemic-chill.title_en: A Few Bright Spots Can't Offset a Systemic Chill
local-boom-systemic-chill.excerpt_en: The biggest misconception about the economy today is trusting the K-shaped story: that a few dazzling tech sectors can pull the whole economy out of the mud. The data says otherwise.

ma-army-story.title_en: The Ma Family Army: The Myth and the Drugs Behind It
ma-army-story.excerpt_en: In 1993, a team of teenage Chinese girls shattered world records and became national heroes. Behind the glory was a regime of forced doping, brutal training, and a coach who treated his athletes like machines.

medical-cost.title_en: How Much Does a Serious Illness Cost?
medical-cost.excerpt_en: A cold costs almost nothing, but one serious illness can bankrupt a family. In China, health insurance has no out-of-pocket cap — and that open-ended gap can swallow everything a family has.

melbourne-delivery-driver.title_en: The Death of a Chinese Delivery Rider That Brought a Whole City to Silence
melbourne-delivery-driver.excerpt_en: A Chinese food delivery rider in Australia was stabbed to death by a homeless man, and the whole city fell silent in mourning. Local figures came to pay their respects and promised his family would be looked after.

rain.excerpt_en: At seventeen, I wrote her letter after letter, trying to hold on to our awkward youth — the foot of space between us on the stairs, the fierce summer sun. Then memory buried it all.

republican-defeat-japan-reaction.title_en: After the Republicans' Big Defeat, Japan's Internet Did Something Absurd
republican-defeat-japan-reaction.excerpt_en: When Republicans lost the 2026 U.S. midterms, Japan reacted more intensely than almost anywhere — its government fretted about being sidelined, while far-right accounts attacked minority candidates who had just won.

tcm-liver-injury.title_en: Herbal Medicine and Liver Damage: China's Leading Cause of Drug-Induced Liver Injury
tcm-liver-injury.excerpt_en: A landmark study of 25,927 patients across 308 hospitals found traditional Chinese medicine and herbal supplements are the single biggest cause of drug-induced liver injury in China — far ahead of any Western drug class.

us-china-stocks-crash.title_en: Tech Stocks Crash in the U.S. and China: Stay Calm as U.S. Stocks Fall — But Never Buy the Dip in A-Shares
us-china-stocks-crash.excerpt_en: U.S. and Chinese tech stocks are crashing at the same time. Here's why most retail investors make money in bull markets and give it all back in bear markets — and what ordinary people should actually do.

wang-juyan-logic-2-deconstruction.title_en: Logic Check: Is Praising a Foreign Company for Following the Rules “Handing a Knife to the Enemy”?
wang-juyan-logic-2-deconstruction.excerpt_en: From a fear-mongering opening to Canon's factory closure and Microsoft's 2024 layoffs, this piece dismantles six fallacies one by one — straw men, false causes, appeals to authority, and a false choice between praising foreign firms and loving your country.

wang-juyan-logic-deconstruction.title_en: Logic Check: Would Giving Africa Aid Money to Ordinary People Really Cause Inflation?
wang-juyan-logic-deconstruction.excerpt_en: Hand the billions spent on aid to Africa back to ordinary people — would prices explode? No. The money already exists; moving it isn't printing it. Four popular arguments, four logical fallacies, taken apart one by one.

xian-not-for-young-people.title_en: Why Xi'an Is No Place for the Young: Three Cases Say It All
xian-not-for-young-people.excerpt_en: A rocket engineer's official letter, a subway line's substandard cables, and a mining contract fought over for fourteen years — three famous cases, one operating system: rank and connections outrank rules and contracts, and the young pay the price.
